       A.  Pricing.  

 All prices are shown in United States dollars ($).  Megabus.com one-way fares start as low as US $1 and are inclusive of any applicable sales taxes. Fares may vary by reservation date, day of travel and demand for seats. $1.00 fares are limited. Fares are subject to change without notice. A $3.99 non-refundable booking fee is charged for all online reservations. This fee is charged to cover administration charges related to your reservation.  Megabus.com reserves the right to impose additional charges.  Calls to the megabus.com reservation hotline are toll free within the United States.  Although reservations made by telephone will be charged at the same rate as those made on the internet, there will be a $7.00 non-refundable booking fee charge (in lieu of the $3.99 fee described above).

 For changes to existing reservations a $3.00 change fee will apply to trips greater than 24 hours from time of departure, a $5.00 change fee will apply for trips 6-24 hours from time of departure and a $7.50 change fee will apply for trips 3-6 hours from time of departure. Any change to your reservation may result in a fare increase. Megabus may offer its best prices to those who make reservations early or choose less popular trips.  Please note that due to the high sales volumes on our website, prices may fluctuate between searches and are not guaranteed until a purchase is paid for and confirmed.

 While ticket prices start at $1.00 on all trips, megabus.com typically only sells a very limited number of $1.00 tickets per trip to the first or initial customers that purchase a ticket for that trip. When demand is high, Megabus Operating Carriers may use two or more buses per trip to accommodate all passengers.  In such instances the addition of an extra bus or buses may not result in additional availability of $1.00 tickets.  Megabus.com reserves the right to limit the number of $1.00 tickets purchased by any one person or entity. 

      B.  Age of Passengers.  

 You must be 18 years of age or over to make travel reservations on megabus.com.  All children under 17 years of age must be accompanied by an adult (17 years of age or over) when traveling on a Megabus Operating Carrier’s motorcoach.  By purchasing a ticket, you confirm you are at least the age of 18 and that any passenger under age 17 will be accompanied by a responsible person 17 years of age or over.  Megabus reserves the right, but is not obligated, to verify the age of any passenger and deny access to anyone under 17 years of age who is not accompanied by a responsible person 17 years of age or over.

      C.  Reservations.  

 When your reservation has been completed, megabus.com will issue you with a confirmation e-mail. It is your responsibility to check that the confirmation issued to you is accurate.  Megabus.com is only responsible for issuing the confirmation in accordance with your request made on this website.  Confirmed reservations are only valid on the trip(s) stated.  All passengers are required to have a valid confirmed reservation regardless of age.  Passengers are required to present a valid reservation number, provided at the time of purchase, when boarding a motorcoach.  If a Megabus Operating Carrier has reason to suspect the fraudulent use of a confirmation, You may be denied transportation on a motorcoach. Your sole remedy would be seek an exchange or refund of the ticket.

      D.  Changes to Reservations.  

 Customers wishing to change a reservation must do so at least 3 hours prior to the departure time of the existing reservation. A trade in fee ($3.00 for trade ins more than 24 hours from departure, $5.00 for trade ins 6 to 24 hours from departure, $7.50 for trade ins 3 to 6 hours from departure) and a $3.99 new reservation fee, or $7 when the change is made by telephone,  is charged for all reservations being changed. The cost of the initial reservation will be credited against the subsequent reservation, less the applicable fees. Should the subsequent reservation be less expensive than the initial reservation, no payment or further credit will be made to the customer and all unused credit will be forfeited. If the initial amount paid is less than the cost of the subsequent reservation, the customer must pay the difference when completing their new reservation.

      E.  Refunds and Cancellations.  

 Reservations with megabus.com may not be refunded or canceled except where a Megabus Operating Carrier has materially failed in its delivery of the service offered by this site.  If reserved seat reservations are not honored but the transportation is still provided, then only the additional cost of a reserved seat price, if any, will be refunded. Megabus Operating Carriers are not responsible for delays or cancellations caused by traffic or road conditions, weather or other causes over which it has no control.  Megabus Operating Carriers will make a reasonable effort to make wi-fi services and other amenities available free of charge to every passenger.  If the wi-fi service or other amenity is unavailable no refund will be issued.   No refund will be made in relation to any confirmation refused due to fraudulent use. 

      F.  Departures.  

 Customers are required to be at their departure point at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time. This allows Megabus Operating Carriers to board customers in a timely manner avoiding any delays that may impact on the departure of the vehicle.  Failure to arrive on time could lead to the forfeiture of your ticket, with no right of refund or credit.  Megabus Operating Carriers reserve the right to right to substitute a replacement vehicle which may not have all of the regular amenities for operational reasons.

       G.  Connecting Travel.  

 Megabus Operating Carriers offer approved connections and will guarantee customer’s travel to their final destinations. These approved connections are available for sale on the megabus.com website and will only require one search and one reservation for travel. Megabus Operating Carriers do not guarantee connections on non-approved connections where multiple reservations are needed to travel to the final destination. If passengers decide to make a non-approved connection, then we require that you allow at least two hours in between trips to account for any delays that may be experienced.  

      H.  Limitations on Luggage.  

 Megabus Operating Carriers do not check luggage or provide receipts for luggage transported with the vehicle by the passenger.  Customers are advised that Megabus Operating Carriers will accept up to ONE (1) piece of luggage per passenger reservation. Such luggage must not exceed 62 inches when adding the total exterior dimensions of the piece (length + width + height).  Passengers can also take onboard one (1) small carry-on bag that will fit in the overhead storage compartments or under the seat. Maximum bag sizes that are commonly used for airline carry-on, such as wheeled, rectangular, bags are typically too large to be taken onboard the bus and will not be permitted in the passenger area.  Megabus Operating Carriers suggest a bag with dimensions no larger than a briefcase as being about the correct size for carriage onto the bus. In the interests of safety and the prevention of injury to employees and associates, no pieces of luggage over 50 pounds in weight are allowed - regardless of whether additional reservations have been purchased or not.  All luggage should be locked and TSA approved locking devices are recommended, particularly if crossing international borders. It is also recommend that you label your luggage with your name, address and contact number. 

 Please be advised that passengers wishing to travel with more luggage than specified above may have items refused. No refunds will be issued in respect of travel plans canceled by the customer as a result of their excess luggage being refused. If you wish to take an extra piece of luggage, subject to the same size and weight restrictions, you may purchase an additional travel ticket in advance of travel. Customers presenting additional pieces of luggage without an additional passenger reservation in New York, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Washington DC, Boston, Atlanta, Orlando, Los Angeles, San Francisco and all Texas cities will be requested to pay the full walk-up fare for the carriage of additional pieces of luggage. Where additional luggage is accepted for travel by the bus operator or dispatcher, Megabus Operating Carriers do not guarantee that the luggage will be carried on any subsequent service the customer intends to use, whether a Megabus Operating Carrier, an approved connection or a non-approved connection.

 Medical devices required for travel are carried in addition to the luggage limitations. Children strollers may also be carried in addition to the luggage limitations, maximum one per passenger, provided that they are properly folded and capable of being stowed in the luggage compartment.  Bicycles, skis, snowboards, golf clubs and musical instruments are not permitted on motorcoaches unless they are in a case that does not exceed the dimensions and weight discussed above. Customers may not transport in their baggage or otherwise any items that are inherently dangerous, including any hazardous materials as that term is defined by the US Department of Transportation, or weapons of any kind.  Megabus operators reserve the right to place further restrictions on items transported for the safety of its passengers, the operator and the motorcoach. 

      I.  Pets and Animals.  

 Megabus Operating Carriers are unable to carry animals, with the exception of trained service animals that allow Passengers with Disabilities to perform necessary activities. Service animals must be properly harnessed and under the direct control of the passenger at all times.

      J.  Beverages/Food/Personal Items.  

 Customers are allowed to bring food and non-alcoholic beverages onboard.  Passengers are not permitted consume or bring alcoholic beverages onboard.  Customers are asked to remove all garbage as a courtesy to other passengers and the operator.  Should any food or beverages be left on the bus unattended in an open manner during a stop, the operator may be permitted to discard such items.  The operator and Megabus will have no liability for any items left unattended.

       K.  No Smoking.  

 Smoking, including the use of electronic simulated smoking materials, e-cigarettes, and smokeless cigarettes, is prohibited in our buses.

      L.  Other Prohibited Items.   

 In addition to the above, any other material or object prohibited by law from carrying or transporting shall be prohibited. 

     M. Seatbelt Use. 

 The majority of our motorcoaches as well as some provided by third-party operating carriers are equipped with passenger seat belts as a safety feature and, when used properly, may reduce serious injury or death if there is an accident.  Safety is our top priority and Coach USA ensures that all its safety protocols are in place for your journey with us.  However, it is encouraged to use the seat belt where available (subject to age restriction or medical exemption) as an additional safety measure as you travel to your destination.

 3.       Transportation on Megabus Vehicles 

      A.        Refusal to Transport Passengers; Right to Remove from Vehicle 

 Megabus Operating Carriers reserve the right to refuse to transport or shall have the right to remove from the motorcoach at any point, any customer for the following reasons:

- Government Request or Regulations.   Whenever such action is necessary to comply with any government regulation, security directive, or any governmental request for emergency transportation in connection with the national defense. 

- Force Majeure and Other Conditions .  Whenever such action is necessary or advisable by reason of weather or other conditions beyond megabus.com control including, but not limited to, acts of God, force majeure, strikes, civil commotions, embargoes, wars, hostilities, terrorist activities, or disturbances, whether actual, threatened, or reported. 

- Across International Boundaries .  Whenever a customer is traveling across any international boundary if: the government required travel documents of such Customer appear not to be in order according to Megabus' reasonable belief; or such customer's embarkation from, transit through, or entry into any country from, through, or to which such customer desires transportation would be unlawful or denied for any reason. 

- Safety .  Whenever refusal or removal of a customer may be necessary for the safety of such customer or other customers or drivers, including, but not limited to:  (a) Persons whose conduct is disorderly, offensive, abusive, illegal or violent; (b) Persons who fail to comply with or interfere with the duties of driver, including the failure to obey instructions from the driver; (c) Persons who wear or have on or about their person, or baggage, concealed or unconcealed deadly or dangerous weapons ; and/or (d) Persons with a communicable disease or infection known or reasonably believed by Megabus to pose a direct threat to the health or safety of others. 

      B.         Recording Policy 

 The vehicles operated by Megabus Operating Carriers may be equipped with video and, audio recording equipment. Video and audio recordings may be viewed at any time for any reason by Megabus personnel.  Such recordings may also be made available to law enforcement, or other government officials, upon request.  Your acceptance of these Terms and Conditions, and/or boarding a vehicle with such equipment, shall constitute consent to any such recordings, and their use.

       C.        Cross-Border Travel 

 Persons traveling across the U.S.-Canada border should ascertain information on documents needed to cross the border from the relevant U.S. and Canadian government agencies, as such requirements are subject to change. A valid passport is required for citizens of any nation, including citizens of the United States and Canada, to cross the border in either direction between the United States and Canada. Passengers are advised to consult with their government if they seek to cross the border without a valid passport. For U.S. Government information, passengers should consult with U.S. Customs and Border Protection at www.cbp.gov. For Canadian Government information, passengers should consult with the Canadian Border Services Agency at  www.cbsa.gc.ca .

 A guardian traveling with children must provide proof of custody or notarized parental authorization for travel. An adult accompanying a child who is neither a parent nor guardian of the child should have written permission from a parent or guardian to accompany the child across the border, including the name and contact information of the parent or guardian.

Luggage is subject to inspection when crossing international borders. You will be asked to declare any items subject to duty upon crossing the border.  Megabus.com is not responsible for any luggage crossing international borders. Passengers must claim all luggage at the border crossing point before proceeding. No luggage is allowed across the border unless claimed by a passenger.

 Megabus Operating Carriers will not provide free transportation to a passenger denied entry across an international border, and no refunds or credits will be provided.

 4.       Dispute Resolution 

      A.        Arbitration. 

 Arbitration procedures are generally simpler than the rules that apply in courts, and discovery is more limited.  Except as specifically outlined herein, you and/or the relevant Megabus Operating Carrier (including any non-affiliated, third-party motorcoach operator referenced above, or otherwise) may elect to resolve any dispute, claim or controversy (collectively “Claims”) by individual arbitration.  Such Claims include, but are not limited to, all disputes between the parties arising out of, or in any way relating to:  motorcoach services; loss, damage or injury to persons and/or property transported by a Megabus Operating Carrier or one of its authorized, non-affiliated motorcoach operators; claims of discrimination; the use of the megabus.com website and its implementation; and these Terms and Conditions or the breach, termination, enforcement, interpretation or validity thereof.

 Arbitration may be commenced by either party at any time.  Except that each party retains the right to bring an individual action in a small claims court of competent jurisdiction and the right to seek injunctive or other equitable relief in a court of competent jurisdiction to prevent the actual or threatened infringement, misappropriation or violation of a party's copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, patents or other intellectual property rights.

 The Federal Arbitration Act will govern the interpretation and enforcement of this Section.

             B.        No Trial by Jury or Class Action / Representative Claims. 

 If arbitration is chosen by either party, neither you nor a Megabus Operating Carrier(s) will have the right to litigate that Claim in court or have a jury trial on that Claim.  By accepting these Terms and Conditions, you acknowledge and agree that you and Megabus are each waiving the right to a trial by jury to any Claim subject to arbitration. 

 If either party elects to resolve a claim by arbitration, that claim will be arbitrated on an individual basis. There will be no right or authority for any claims to be arbitrated on a class action basis or on bases involving claims brought in a purported representative capacity on behalf of the general public, other persons similarly situated.

 The arbitrator's authority is limited to claims between you and Megabus Operating Carrier(s) alone. Claims may not be joined or consolidated unless you and the Megabus Operating Carrier(s) agree in writing.  An arbitration award and any judgment confirming it will apply only to the specific case and cannot be used in any other case except to enforce the award.

             C.        Arbitration Rules and Process. 

 Claims are to be decided by a neutral arbitrator. The arbitration will be administered by the American Arbitration Association (" AAA ") in accordance with the Commercial Arbitration Rules and the Supplementary Procedures for Consumer Related Disputes (the " AAA Rules ") then in effect, except as modified by this "Dispute Resolution" section.  The AAA Rules are available at  www.adr.org  or by calling the AAA at 1-800-778-7879.

 A party who desires to initiate arbitration must provide the other party with a written Demand for Arbitration as specified in the AAA Rules.  The AAA provides a form Demand for Arbitration on its website.  The arbitrator will be either a retired judge or an attorney licensed to practice law and will be selected by the parties from the AAA's roster of consumer dispute arbitrators.  If the parties are unable to agree upon an arbitrator within thirty (30) days of delivery of the Demand for Arbitration, then the AAA will appoint the arbitrator in accordance with the AAA Rules.

             D.        Arbitration Location and Procedure 

 Unless you and Megabus Operating Carrier(s) agree otherwise in writing, the arbitration will be conducted in the county where you reside.  In the event that you reside outside of the continental United States, the arbitration will be conducted in the county of your departure.

 If your claim does not exceed $10,000, then the arbitration will be conducted solely on the basis of documents you and Megabus submit to the arbitrator, unless you request a hearing or the arbitrator determines that a hearing is necessary.  If your claim exceeds $10,000, your right to a hearing will be determined by the AAA Rules.  Subject to the AAA Rules, the arbitrator will have the discretion to direct a reasonable exchange of information by the parties, consistent with the expedited nature of the arbitration.

             E.        Arbitrator’s Decision. 

 The arbitrator's decision is as enforceable as any court order and is subject to very limited review by a court. The arbitrator will render an award within the time frame specified in the AAA Rules. The arbitrator's decision will include the essential findings and conclusions upon which the arbitrator based the award.  Judgment on the arbitration award may be entered in any court having jurisdiction thereof.

             F.         Fees. 

 Your responsibility to pay any AAA filing, administrative and arbitrator fees will be solely as set forth in the AAA Rules. However, if your claim for damages does not exceed $75,000, Megabus will pay all such fees, unless the Arbitrator finds that either the substance of your claim or the relief sought in your Demand for Arbitration was frivolous or was brought for an improper purpose (as measured by the standards set forth in Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 11(b)).

## # Privacy policy
As of November 8, 2023 

 You are a valued customer of Megabus (“Megabus,” “us,” or “we”) and we take your privacy very seriously.  This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) is intended to inform you about the information we may collect from you or that you may provide to us, and our practices for collecting, using, maintaining, protecting, and disclosing that information.  The Policy applies to bus transportation, travel and leisure and other related products and services offered by Megabus, the websites of Megabus’ related or affiliated entities  (with the exception of Coach USA-related entities which have their own terms and privacy policy) (the “Website”) or by phone, and any other website or mobile application that utilizes this Policy (collectively, “Services”).  Please be assured that Megabus will only use your information in accordance with this Policy. 

 Who We Are 

 While this Privacy Policy governs the Website and Services , our Services are provided by the “Megabus Service Providers” a term that encompasses “Operating Carrier(s)”, a term that is defined to encompass the various affiliated and non-affiliated third-party motorcoach operating carriers, tour operators, charter companies, contract service providers and other subsidiaries and affiliates (“Megabus Service Providers”) that may transport passengers, or sell and fulfill products or services. This does not include Coach USA and its related entities as have their own terms and privacy policy.  The term “Megabus” herein may include the individual Megabus Service Provider providing the service.  A list of Megabus Service Providers adopting this Policy is maintained here . 

 Note: The individual Megabus Operating Carrier utilized, and the particular route traveled by that operator , is subject to change, without notice, and as circumstances warrant.  In addition, the Megabus Service Provider offering and fulfilling the product or service purchased may be different than the original Megabus Service Provider as circumstances may warrant.

 While Megabus operates the Website, it does not itself transport any passengers, and is not responsible for the goods or services offered or provided by the individual Megabus Service Provider, in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada.  Similarly, Megabus is not a Megabus Operating Carrier and does not provide any motorcoach services, as outlined herein.

 Our service may on occasion be provided by certain authorized, non-affiliated, third-party motorcoach operators or other service providers with whom we maintain operating arrangements or other agreements.  In these situations, we serve only as a sales agent and we assume no responsibility or liability of any kind whatsoever for the independent services they provide. A list of the non-affiliated third-party motorcoach carriers is maintained here  . There are times where exigent circumstances require that a non-affiliated third-party motorcoach carrier not listed here is needed.  In such occasions, we will only provide the non-affiliated carrier with only the basic information needed for it to accept your ticket and to provide the Services requested, and to the extent reasonably possible, we will endeavor to demand that such parties keep this information confidential and agree to similar privacy protections as listed herein.

 While Megabus will be the data controller for your information, we operate internationally and through local affiliated and authorized non-affiliated entities.  As such, subsidiaries and affiliates of Megabus or where applicable authorized non-affiliated entities may also have access to your information where they collect it or perform services on behalf of us or other data controller(s) who have access to your information (as a data processor) or use on their own behalf (as a data controller), pursuant to contractual protections regarding your information.

 The information we collect from you and how we use it 

 Generally, you are the source of the information we collect because you provide it to us when you are purchasing a ticket, making a reservation for our Services, engaging in transactions and communications with us, or otherwise providing information to us.  We may also obtain information about you from other sources, such as through the website, during the collection of tickets and when signing into the Wi-Fi offered on our fleet or at certain locations. 

 If you make a reservation on any Megabus Service Provider website Under Our Control or otherwise engage in a transaction or communication with us: 

 We may ask you to provide information such as:

- Your Name 

- Email Address(e) 

- Phone Number(s), including cell phone numbers 

- Fax Number(s) 

- Home/Billing/Mailing Address(es) 

- Payment Method Preferences 

- Date of Birth and/or Age 

- Travel Preferences 

- Disability and/or Your Requirements For Accommodations During Travel 

- Purpose of the Trip (business or leisure) 

 Within the past twelve months, Megabus has collected the following categories of consumers’ Personal Data (including inferences drawn therefrom to create consumer profiles):

- Your Name 

- Email Address(es) 

- Phone Number(s), including cell phone numbers 

- Fax Number(s) 

- Home/Billing/Mailing Address(es) 

- Past Purchasing Behavior 

- Internet Protocol (IP) Address 

- Payment Method Preferences 

- Date of Birth and/or Age 

- Travel Preferences 

- Disability and/or Your Requirements For Accommodations During Travel 

- Approximate Location 

- Purpose of the trip (business or leisure 

 The purposes of requesting that you provide us with this information are: to process your purchase and/or your reservation/transaction, to provide the Services or quotes requested by you, to provide you with information about your reservation and transactions, including confirmations and updates on the Services requested, to respond to your inquiries or comments, to fulfill the services you have requested, to collect, manage, or recover amounts owed to us, to conduct fraud checks as appropriate, and to send you information about promotions or offers from Us, our affiliates, or non-affiliating operating carriers, and about changes to our website. The legal bases for processing this information is to satisfy performance of a contract with you or for our legitimate interests in collecting, managing, or recovering amounts owed to us, in taking steps to prevent fraud, and in growing our business.

 SMS Marketing 

 As part of our goal to communicate travel plans and provide special offers, we have an opt in feature on our Website where Megabus can now provide you with this information through text messaging.

 You may elect to receive text messages from us. When you sign up to receive text messages, we will send you information about promotional offers and more These messages may use information automatically collected based on your actions while on our sites and may prompt messaging such as cart abandon messages (IE Cookies). To the extent you voluntarily opt to have Text notifications sent directly to your mobile phone, we receive and store the information you provide, including your telephone number or when you read a text message. You may opt out of receiving text messages at any time by texting “STOP” to our text messages. For more information about text messages, see our Terms and Conditions. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties, excluding aggregators and providers of the Text Message services.

 If you participate in the My Account service 

 If you take advantage of our My Account service, we may ask you to provide additional information when you register.  This information may include:

- Your Name 

- Email Address(e) 

- Phone Number(s), including cell phone numbers 

- Fax Number(s) 

- Home/Billing/Mailing Address(es) 

- Payment Method Preferences 

- Date of Birth and/or Age 

- Travel preferences 

- Disability and/or Your Requirements For Accommodations During Travel 

- Purpose of the Trip (business or leisure) 

 We may also track your frequency of travel, the amounts spent and payment history.  The purposes of requesting that you provide us with this information are: to allow our frequent travelers to save time during the reservation process by allowing us to automatically populate certain fields, to allow you to review reservations that you have made with us, and to allow our customer service agents to assist you with any questions or follow up requests you may have.   We may also review this information to provide targeted marketing to you and to ensure that customers whose payment history is poor do not take opportunities from our valued customers.  We may also use this information to enable us to deliver a more effective and targeted service to you, the passenger.  We may use information about your computer equipment and the pages on our Services that you visited for statistical evaluation.  The legal bases for processing this information is to satisfy performance of a contract with you and in furtherance of our and your legitimate interests.

 If you request disability assistance 

 If you advise us that you will require special assistance during your trip because of a disability, in order to comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act, we may ask you for additional information, including: 

- Your disability 

- Your special requirements 

 The purpose of requesting that you provide us with this information is to accommodate your requests for special assistance and to comply with our legal obligations. The legal bases for processing this information is to satisfy performance of a contract with you, complying with our legal obligations, and in furtherance of our and your legitimate interests.

 And, you may provide additional information to us that you believe to be pertinent.

 Information we automatically collect when you access our services   

 When you access our Services we may, but will not be obligated to automatically collect: 

- The type of Web browser and operating system you have used to access our Services; 

- The type of device you have used to access our Services, including unique device identifiers; 

- Your IP address (which is a number automatically assigned to your device when you access the Internet and can be used to derive your general geographic location); 

- The websites you visit before and after you visit our Services; 

- Information about the content you view and the actions you take on our Services (e.g. search queries, transaction order history); 

- Information about your current location (if you consent to providing us this information); and 

- Information we collect using cookies, as described in our Cookie Policy  . 

 We may use third-party providers to help us collect some of this information.   For more information on how we use cookies, please see our Cookie Policy .

 Tracking and Do Not Track requests 

 Although some browsers allow you to send a signal indicating that you do not wish to be "tracked," our Services do not recognize or respond to "Do Not Track" signals.  Third parties may also “track” your online activities across this website, on other websites, and over time.  

 You have a right to request that we cease processing your information. For more information on your rights or to exercise your rights, please contact us at questions@us.megabus.com ; or by contacting us at 877-462-6342;   or by forwarding information to Megabus at 160 S Route 17N, Paramus, NJ  07652, Attn: Privacy Officer. –

 Sharing of your information 

 Megabus does not sell its consumers Personal Data to third parties, and within the past twelve (12) months, Megabus has not “sold” consumers’ Personal Data to any third parties (as the terms “sale,” “sell, ” or “sold” are defined under the California Consumer Privacy Act).

 Megabus does not share your personal information for a business purpose with any third parties except in compliance with this Policy, and as further discussed above, within the past twelve (12) months, has disclosed the following categories of consumers’ personal data for a business purpose to third parties: (i) Name; (ii) Mailing Address; (iii) Email Address; (iv) Phone Number; (v) Date of Birth; ; (vi) Disability (if any); (vii) Payment Method Preference; (viii) Unique Personal Identifier or Internet Protocol Address; (ix) Internet Activity Information, including browsing history, search history, and information regarding interaction with websites, applications, or advertisements; (x) Geolocation data (with consent); and (xi) Inferences drawn from any of the above-identified information, to create consumer profiles.

 Payment transactions on our website are handled by several different payment processors, depending on the service provider.  These include Worldpay and Google Pay (“GPay). These are secure payment processing providers. Your credit card and related personal details are collected by these payment processors in order to process your payment. More details regarding their terms and conditions, and privacy and security policies can be found by visiting   worldpay.com and policies.google.com . 

 We also use Riskified to assist in preventing fraudulent online transactions.  As such data may be shared with Riskified to verify online transactions.  More details regarding Riskified’s terms and conditions, privacy and security policies can be found by visiting www.Riskified.com .

 If you accessed our Services from a third party website, we may provide your information to that third party for purposes of enabling the third party to collect payment.

 We may provide your information to companies that provide operational services directly to us, including our website designers, technical consultants and digital marketing agencies. This information will be used by such organizations only to perform their functions in order for us to provide the Services you have requested, or to improve our Services, and for no other purpose.

 If you are an existing customer of Megabus or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates or Megabus Service Providers, we may use your email address to provide you with information about promotions and services we think may be of interest to you; however, you can choose not to receive such notices. If you are simply a visitor to this website and not an existing customer, we may nonetheless wish to give you the opportunity to receive such information and may ask for your consent to do so. Your information may also be disclosed to Megabus or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates or Megabus Service Providers for purposes of statistical and business analysis and for purposes of improving on our delivery of service.

 In the event of the sale or transfer of our company or some of its assets, information we have collected from you or about you may be disclosed to the buyer and its agents as part of the sale or transfer process and may be transferred to the buyer as one of the transferred assets.  Some information may also be made available to a prospective buyer and its agents during the due diligence process.

 Handling of your information may currently take place in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada, but in the event your information is transferred internationally (this includes the use of Worldpay which may result in such transfer internationally), such transfer will be in compliance with necessary safeguards under applicable law.    

 You may request a copy of these safeguards related to the international transfer of your Personal Information, if applicable, by contacting us at questions@us.megabus.com 

 We may share your personal information with companies, governmental agencies, organizations or individuals if required by law or if we have a good-faith belief that access, use, preservation or disclosure of the information is reasonably necessary to:

- Comply with any applicable law, regulation, legal process or enforceable governmental request. 

- Enforce our Terms of Use, including investigation of potential violations. 

- Address fraud, security or technical issues. 

- Assist with the location of missing or abducted children or adults, or fugitives from the law. 

- Protect against harm to the rights, property or safety of Megabus, our customers or the public as required or permitted by law. 

 It is not our policy to provide any further entities or organization(s) with your information provided to us via this website, unless we determine on a good faith basis that it is legally required or necessary to protect our Services.

 Your Rights 

 With respect to your information, you may, depending upon your residency, have the following rights:

- Right of access, including the right to request confirmation as to whether information about you is being processed and the right to request a copy of any such information about you; 

- Right to rectification, including the right to request that we update any information about you that is inaccurate or incomplete; 

- Right to erasure, including the right to request that we delete information about you; 

- Right to restriction of processing, including the right to request that we restrict the processing of information about you; 

- Right to data portability, including the right to request that we transfer information about you to a third party; 

- Right to object, including the right to request that we cease processing information about you; and 

- Right to not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects or significantly affects you. 

 For more information on your rights or to exercise your rights, please contact us at questions@us.megabus.com  or by contacting us at 877-462-6342 and submitting the information below.

 Upon reasonable verification of your identity, we will take reasonable steps to meet your requests in a timely manner and free of charge, but we may need to ask that you provide us with additional information in order to do so, to speed up our response time, to protect the rights and freedom of others, to comply with any applicable laws or regulations, or for other similar reasons. If we find that a request is unfounded, not required or excessive, we may charge a reasonable fee or refuse to act on the request.

 In submitting the request, in order to allow us to verify your identity, please provide us with a copy of a government issued identification, the email address you associated with information you provided to us, and the action being requested of us.  In addition:

- To the extent you are seeking to rectify information about you that is inaccurate or incomplete, you must provide us with notice of the information that is inaccurate or incomplete, the reason that you are requesting it be changed, certification that the change is accurate and the substance of the change.  

- To the extent that you are seeking erasure, you must provide us with notice of the information that is to be erased and should advise the reason for the deletion.  

- To the extent that you are requesting that we restrict the processing of information about you, you must provide us with any additional contact information or login information that you are using to allow us to identify you. 

- To the extent that you are requesting that we transfer information about you to a third party, you must provide us with the specific identification of information you want transferred and the name, address, email address and phone number of the third-party to whom you want the information transferred; 

- To the extent that you are requesting that we cease processing information about you, you must provide us with any additional contact information or login information that you are using to allow us to identify you. 

- To the extent that you are requesting that you not be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects or significantly affects you, you must provide us with any additional contact information or login information that you are using to allow us to identify you. 

 We reserve the right to deny a consumer’s verified request, in whole or in part, because of a conflict with federal or state law, or an exception set forth in the applicable law.  We also reserve the right to deny a request if we cannot verify the identity of the requester.

 You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority governing your jurisdiction.

 Accuracy of Personal Information Provided 

 If the credit card holder for reservations is not you, it will be your responsibility to ensure that you have the card holder’s consent before entering any related details, and that such details when entered are true. Other than the foregoing, by using our Services, you confirm that you will only enter personal information about yourself and that such information is true.  If you become aware of any inaccurate information about yourself held or used by us and you cannot change such information yourself, please contact us and we will attempt to rectify.   Providing false information to us (including but not limited to a false name, country of origin, anonymized IP address, or other inaccurate or deceptive information) is a violation of this Policy by you.

 Protection of information 

 We use reasonable physical, technical, and administrative measures to safeguard information in our possession against loss, theft and unauthorized use, disclosure, or modification. Please note, however, that no data transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect the information we maintain, we cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information that you transmit to us or that we transmit to you.

 Retention of information 

 We endeavor not to retain information about you in an identifiable and non-anonymized form for longer than necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed or for as long as we maintain an ongoing relationship with you, plus the duration of any applicable statute of limitations period in which we may be subject to a legal claim. If any claim, legal process, or enforceable government request is brought, we may continue to retain your information for an additional time as necessary to protect our legal interests or to comply with any applicable law, regulation, legal process or enforceable governmental request.

 We reserve the right to and may retain information about you beyond the above retention criteria for statistical purposes, and information retained for such purposes will be in anonymized form that is not identifiable to you.

 Children 

 Our Services are intended for a general audience.  We do not knowingly collect, use, or disclose personal information from children under the age of 13 without prior parental consent, except as permitted by the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act.  If you are a parent who consents to the collection of personal information from your child, you agree that your child may use all our Services and that we may collect, use, and disclose your child’s personal information consistent with this Privacy Policy.

 Third-party websites and services 

 Our Services may link to websites or other online services operated by third-party companies (e.g., websites where you can book hotel accommodations or other services).  We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties.  Once you have left our Services, you should check the applicable privacy policy of the third party website or service to determine how the third party will handle any information it collects from you.

 Your California Privacy Rights 

 If you are a California resident, you may have certain additional rights.

 The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), provides that California residents have the following rights with respect to their personal information collected by businesses subject to the CCPA: (i) to opt-out of the “sale” (as defined under the CCPA) of their Personal Data (however, as noted under the section entitled “Sharing of your information,” Megabus does not “sell” consumers’ personal information); (ii) to access their personal information in a format transmittable to another entity; (iii) to deletion of their personal information; (iv) to not be discriminated against due to exercise of the above-listed rights, such as through a denial of goods or services, receiving a different level or quality of goods or services, or being charged different prices for goods or services, and (v) to receive, pursuant to a verifiable consumer request, a disclosure of the following requested information: (a) the categories of sources from which the consumer’s Personal Data is collected (also disclosed in this Privacy Policy); (b) our business or commercial purpose(s) for collecting or selling Personal Data (also disclosed in this Privacy Policy); (c) the categories of third parties with whom we share personal information (also disclosed in this Privacy Policy); (d) the categories of personal information we have collected about that consumer; and (e) the specific pieces of personal information we have collected about that consumer. 

 Similarly, California Civil Code Section 1798.83 permits you to request information regarding the disclosure of your personal information to third parties for the third parties’ direct marketing purposes.

 To make such any such requests or exercise the above rights, please contact us at:

 questions@us.megabus.com 

 with "California Privacy Request" in the email subject line. You must include sufficient detail for us to locate your file; at a minimum, your name, email and postal address.   Do not send payment card, bank account details or any passwords.  Please note we are not required to respond to requests that are made more than twice in any 12-month period by the same California consumer.

 To the extent an authorized agent is making a request on your behalf, the authorized agent must submit, in addition to the information required of the requester as noted above, a government issued identification of the authorized agent, and a signed letter of authorization by the requester which includes specific instructions allowing for the authorized agent to act on behalf of the requester.  We reserve the right, but are not obligated, to seek verification of the requester, and can deny any request that cannot be verified.

 Further, California Business and Professions Code Section 22581 permits registered users who are minors to request and obtain deletion of certain posted content. Such minor or his parent or guardian may be able to request and obtain removal of content or information the minor has publicly posted. To make such a request, please send an email with a detailed description of the specific content or information (with the url of the posted content) to questions@us.megabus.com with Section 22581 “Removal Request” in the email subject line. Please be aware that such a request does not ensure complete or comprehensive removal of the content or information you have posted and that there may be circumstances in which the law does not require or allow removal even if requested.

 Modification of this policy 

 We reserve the right to change this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted here.

 For more information 

 For more information or any questions regarding our practices or this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at questions@us.megabus.com.

## # Partners
Megabus is focusing on establishing partnerships with other carriers and selling tickets for their routes on our website. We’re constantly looking to grow as a business by expanding our network of affiliates to reach more customers and provide more and more travel options for them. You just have to provide the buses and drivers, and then we do the rest! If you’re considering to partner with Megabus, here are just a few reasons why you should do so:


## ## Multiple Stops, One Transaction
Our vast network of 500+ North American cities is comprised of numerous partner-operated routes . When customers buy bus tickets with Megabus, we offer options to take them from their point of origin to their final destination in one transaction across multiple partners (if needed). We're pleased to provide convenient options for travelers, which is why all Megabus tickets can conveniently be purchased  online  as well!


## ## Access to Centralized Megabus Team Services
Why worry about handling your own customer inquiries when we can do that for you? When you partner with Megabus, we make your riders’ experiences as seamless and stress-free as possible, and that is made possible by our award-winning customer service team, dedicated IT support crew, and data-driven marketing campaigns. We take the work out of your hands so your team can focus on what’s most important: ensuring passengers get to their destination safely and efficiently.


## ## State-Of-The-Art Website and Sales Engine
No one does online bus ticketing like Megabus does. All transactions can be made online easily within minutes, but that’s only scratching the surface on how you can leverage sales through our website. You can also have:

- Advanced scheduling software managed by an experienced team 

- Dynamic pricing that changes depending on numerous variables 

- Proven retail pricing strategies 

- Options for reserved seating, discounts, and price comparisons 

- Detailed revenue reporting and analysis by route 

 We didn’t just tailor our website for customer convenience – we’ve also set it up to drive sales and help businesses succeed. We are an ever-growing leader in the ground transportation industry, so we make sure to utilize top-of-the-line software and business practices to ensure we and our partners always come out on top.


## ## Nationally Recognized Brand
As we previously mentioned, our network includes more than 500 cities across the United States and Canada. Having been in business for almost 20 years, Megabus has become a trusted brand among ground travelers – when customers purchase tickets with us, they know they can rely on the trustworthy services we’ve been providing ever since our inception. Click here to learn more about who we are, and click here to see what we have to offer our customers. We look forward to working with you as you begin to partner with Megabus!

## ##

## # Customers with disabilities
Megabus is committed to providing accessible transportation service to customers with special requirements and does not discriminate on the basis of disability. We welcome all customers on Megabus and can provide assistance to those with walking difficulties, those who normally use wheelchairs or scooters, and customers with service animals and breathing aids, among others.


## ## How do I make a reservation?
Customers with special requirements can now make reservations through the Megabus website.  

 Just select yes when asked if there are any passengers travelling with special requirements and answer a few simple questions that will allow us to do our very best to accommodate you.  

 Customers are also welcome to call 1-877-GO2-MEGA (1-877-462-6342) to have one of our dedicated customer service representatives assist them with their reservation.


## ## Additional information
Whenever one of our buses makes an intermediate or rest stop, a customer with a disability is permitted to leave and return to the bus in the same manner as any other customer .

 If you are a disabled customer traveling on a bus without a handicap accessible restroom making an express run of three hours or more without a rest stop, and you are unable to use the inaccessible restroom, you may request an unscheduled rest stop.

 Megabus is obligated to provide accessible transportation service to customers with disabilities. 

 If you believe that Megabus has failed to fulfill this obligation or that you have been discriminated against on the basis of your disability, please contact Tammy Daniel in any of the following ways:
1.    Email: t.daniel@coachusa.com 
2.    Telephone: 908-372-6195

service_alerts.title: Philadelphia stop temporarily moved for departing services
service_alerts.body: From Monday 5 October to Monday 12 October 2026, Peter Pan Bus Lines and Adirondack Trailways services departing Philadelphia will board from Platform C at 1001 Filbert Street instead of the usual gates. Allow an extra 10 minutes to find the new boarding point. Arrivals are not affected.

service_alerts.title: Thanksgiving 2026 schedules are now open for booking
service_alerts.body: Services for the Thanksgiving travel period (Wednesday 25 November to Sunday 29 November 2026) are now on sale. The busiest travel days fill quickly - book early for the best fares and a reserved seat on your preferred departure.
